sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Detailed study guide and resources for Jainism are currently being prepared. Check back soon for comprehensive explanations, summary diagrams, and expert preparation recommendations.

Key Dimensions of Study:

  • Life and teachings of Lord Mahavira.
  • Jain philosophy: Anekantavada, Syadvada, and Aparigraha.
  • Sects: Digambara and Svetambara.
  • Contributions to Indian art, architecture, and literature.
